title: Live object-scope repair is trial code, not accepted source history
summary: For emulator live repair, a Gopher view may show a running #OBJECT trial method beside the accepted instance/class-side method and the machine journal point/code epoch. Installing trial code, rewinding and retrying proves runtime evidence; it does not itself mutate accepted SSC history. Persistent source is authored and accepted separately.
invariants: Machine/data history, code epoch/source revision and freeze evidence are orthogonal.
State rewind does not remove newly installed trial code.
#OBJECT trial identity must not overwrite the accepted instance/class method identity.
Qualification can cite a successful live retry without treating it as source acceptance.
